description: Tenant.so is an all-in-one community operating system that consolidates community spaces, a full LMS, email campaigns, events, gamification, AI assistant, automation engine, and monetization into a single platform. Features include real-time chat, drip courses with auto-captions, smart member matchmaking, 60+ financial calculators, license key management, and 30+ integrations. 0% transaction fees on all payments including cards, BNPL, ACH, and crypto.
